newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse bucks Euro trend, but volume thin.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse bucks Euro trend, but volume thin.

text.p: The Brussels bourse bucked the general light European downturn on Thursday to clock up general gains, but traders said there was no specific focus in the market and volume was very thin.
"There is a lack of news, a lack of institutional buyers. No one knows what to buy today," one trader said.

At 0900 GMT the Bel-20 blue chip share index was 6.18 points or 0.27 percent higher at 2,253.88, with 16 gainers, one unchanged and three losers. A scant 250 million francs of shares had changed hands.
Retailer GIB was 2.0 percent up at 1,540 francs after losing ground on Wednesday.
Property company Immobel was up 1.8 percent at 2,500 francs after positive comments at Wednesday's annual meeting.

Steel cord and wire maker Bekaert was up 1.6 percent at 21,125 francs on positive sentiment, while non-ferrous metals firm Union Miniere was up 0.8 percent at 2,955 francs on news late Wednesday the company would make an exchange offer for the rest of its 54 percent owned diamond subsidiary Sibeka.
